value.name: Player value model
value.about: Goals above a replacement-level player in the same role (GAR), from the box score and match rating, fitted on the site's own match data.

valuation.name: Valuation model
valuation.about: A fair transfer value from the player's value added, age, contract and role.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: The pooled Dixon-Coles fit across competitions: attack and defence ratings on one scale, with the line-up term.

gar90: Goals of expected goal difference a player adds per 90 minutes over a replacement-level player in the same role, from the site's player value model (box score plus match rating).
rating: Sofascore's 1-10 match rating, averaged over the player's matches and weighted by minutes.
aerials_won_90: Headers won against an opponent per 90.
padj_tkl_int_90: Tackles plus interceptions per 90, scaled up for players whose team has the ball a lot (fewer chances to defend) and down for those who defend all game.
opp_half_passes_90: Completed passes in the opponent's half per 90: how much of the team's play in the attacking half goes through the player.
pass_pct: Share of passes that find a team-mate. It also reflects how risky the passing is.
long_ball_pct: Share of long passes that find a team-mate.
duels_won_90: Ground and aerial duels won per 90.
duel_pct: Share of ground and aerial duels won.
recoveries_90: Loose balls won back for the team, per 90.
clearances_90: Clearances per 90. Mostly says how much the team is under pressure, not how good the player is.
blocks_90: Shots and passes blocked per 90. Mostly a sign of how much the team defends.
long_balls_90: Long passes that find a team-mate, per 90.
prog_carries_90: Carries that move the ball well upfield, per 90.
loss_per_100: How often the ball is given away for every 100 touches: ball security, whatever the volume.
shot_creation_90: Shots taken plus passes that led to a team-mate's shot, per 90: how often the player ends or sets up an attack.
npxg_xa_90: Non-penalty expected goals plus expected assists per 90: the quality of the chances taken and set up.
on_npxgd_90: Team xG difference, player on the pitch
The team's non-penalty xG minus the opponent's with the player on the pitch, per 90. Mostly measures the team, not the player.
prog_dist_90: Metres the ball is moved towards goal by passing and carrying, per 90 (Sofascore's total progression).
key_passes_90: Passes that lead directly to a team-mate's shot, per 90.
crosses_90: Crosses that reach a team-mate, per 90.
prog_actions_90: Carries that move the ball well upfield plus successful take-ons, per 90: how much the player moves the team forward with the ball at their feet.
xa_90: The chance that each pass is turned into a goal, added up per 90: chances created, whatever the finish.
dribbles_90: Successful take-ons per 90: beating a defender with the ball.
hsr_km_90: Distance covered at high speed and sprinting per 90 (not every league has tracking data).
carries_90: Times the player moves with the ball per 90.
ball_wins_90: Tackles won, interceptions and recoveries per 90.
npxg_90: Expected goals from the player's own shots per 90, penalties left out: how good the chances are, and how many there are.
big_chances_90: Passes that set up a chance a player would be expected to score, per 90.
ga_90: Goals plus assists per 90 minutes, penalties included.
dribble_pct: Share of take-ons that succeed. Too noisy in one season to rank on.
touches_90: Touches of the ball per 90: how involved the player is.
finishing: Non-penalty goals minus non-penalty xG, per shot. Fun to look at, but in one season it is almost all luck: it does not carry over to the next.
sot_90: Shots that would have gone in without the goalkeeper, per 90.
xg_per_shot: The average quality of the player's shots: high means shooting from good positions.
xgot_90: Expected goals of shots on target, judged after the shot from where it was placed, per 90.
fouled_90: Times the player is fouled per 90.
g_minus_xg: Goals minus expected goals. Mostly luck in one season.
goals_prevented_90: Expected goals on target faced minus goals conceded, per 90: shot-stopping above or below an average keeper. Takes several seasons to separate skill from luck.
save_pct: Share of shots on target saved. Depends on the shots faced; noisy within a season.
high_claims_90: Crosses and high balls caught or punched clear per 90: commanding the box.
sweeper_90: Times the keeper comes off the line to deal with a ball behind the defence, per 90.
saves_90: Saves per 90. Mostly says how busy the defence leaves the keeper.
conceded_90: Goals conceded per 90. Mostly about the team in front of the keeper.

xg_diff: Expected goals for minus against per match: the underlying margin, the best single guide to future results.
sot_diff: Shots on target for minus against per match: as stable as xG difference and about as predictive, with no model behind it.
field_tilt: Touches in the opponent's box as a share of touches in both boxes: which end the game is played in.
big_chances: Chances a player would be expected to score, created per match.
possession: Share of the ball. A style marker more than a quality one, but stable.
ppda: Opponent passes per tackle, interception or foul: low means the team presses high.
xpts_per_match: Points per match the team's chances were worth. Nearly identical to xG difference.
shot_quality: Average xG of the team's shots.
shot_quality_against: Average xG of the shots the team allows.
finishing: Goals minus xG per match. Barely carries over from one half of a season to the next.
keeping: xG against minus goals conceded per match. Does not carry over at all within a season.
luck: Points minus expected points per match. Mostly luck; it tends to even out.

view.why: Centre-backs: possession-adjusted tackles and interceptions against passes into the opponent's half, coloured by value added per 90.
Full-backs and wing-backs: carrying the ball upfield against expected goals plus assists, coloured by value added per 90.
Midfielders: passes into the opponent's half against expected goals plus assists, coloured by value added per 90.
Attacking midfielders and wingers: shot creation against expected goals plus assists, coloured by value added per 90.
Strikers: non-penalty xG per 90 (getting into scoring positions) against goals plus assists, coloured by value added per 90.
Goalkeepers: goals prevented (shot-stopping above an average keeper) against passing accuracy, coloured by value added per 90.
